variant_perception: Full Research v1先用单点一致预期再自行生成情景，导致2027上行情景截断。v2先恢复H1后研报的完整expectation envelope，再用存储景气持续性、MCU/定制化存储增长、供给响应、现金转化和估值压缩去保留或否定各世界。

market_expectation_map.interpretation: Sell-side estimates define the market-observable expectation envelope only; they are not future facts or probabilities.

normalized_earnings_notes: v2不再把100亿元base/135亿元upside当完整状态空间。保留95/128/158/180/205亿元五个2027 recurring-earnings worlds；H1约19.74亿元非经常性损益不赋终值倍数。
valuation_framework: 2027归一化净利 / 701,749,599股 × 分情景P/E；五个世界覆盖快速正常化、部分正常化、研报核心区和超预期右尾。先构建expectation envelope，再赋概率。

fundamental_clock_assessment.evidence: H1 recurring earnings/storage margin surged; MCU and custom-memory/product breadth are expanding.
fundamental_clock_assessment.risk: Storage economics remain cycle-sensitive and H1 margin is unusually high.

expectation_clock_assessment.evidence: Fresh post-H1 reports cluster around roughly CNY 14-18bn of 2027 net profit, while the broader 21-institution range is much wider.
expectation_clock_assessment.implication: Do not truncate serious market worlds before underwriting them; upside still requires evidence, not consensus obedience.

liquidity_clock_assessment.evidence: H-share listing changed the capital base before PIT.
liquidity_clock_assessment.implication: Cash and financing capacity do not replace recurring owner earnings and must not be double counted.

monitoring_indicators: 季度存储收入、毛利率、ASP与库存联动
MCU/定制化存储收入、毛利率及量产客户进展
经营现金流、营运资本与H股后资本配置
利基存储新增供给、合同价与客户库存变化
H1后2027盈利预测的继续上修/下修及估值倍数变化
monitoring_falsifiers: Specialty-memory revenue or gross margin normalizes materially faster than the retained worlds while inventory rises and cash conversion weakens.
Recurring 2027 earnings evidence trends below the rapid-normalization world despite stable end demand, implying the model still overstates cycle durability.
MCU, custom-memory and other non-storage products fail to scale economically enough to offset storage normalization.
New supply or customer inventory adjustment materially shortens the 2027 specialty-memory tightness assumed in the central worlds.
Post-H-share capital allocation, procurement dependence or working-capital intensity reduces per-share owner returns without an offsetting operating advantage.

valuation_stress_spec.valuation_regime_stress: terminal P/E varies by world; no single fair multiple

scenario_details.description: Specialty-memory pricing and margin normalize quickly; non-memory growth cannot fully offset the cycle, but recurring earnings remain above the pre-inflection base.
scenario_details.notes: Retained downside world after expectation-envelope reconstruction.

scenario_details.description: Storage economics partially normalize while MCU/custom-memory growth supports a stronger recurring base than v1 assumed.
scenario_details.notes: Below the fresh post-H1 report cluster but above v1 base.

scenario_details.description: Specialty-memory economics remain materially above prior-cycle levels and product breadth supports the lower half of the fresh post-H1 analyst cluster.
scenario_details.notes: Central retained world inside the market-observable expectation envelope.

scenario_details.description: Storage tightness persists longer and MCU/custom-memory growth compounds, supporting the upper end of fresh post-H1 analyst forecasts without relying on fair-value gains.
scenario_details.notes: High-core world near the observed sell-side upper cluster.

scenario_details.description: A genuine right tail where specialty-memory economics stay unusually strong and non-storage products exceed the current report cluster; retained explicitly rather than silently omitted.

assumptions.storage_cycle: longer and stronger than current central expectation

scenario_details.notes: Economically arguable right tail, deliberately low probability rather than deleted.
